primary_estimand: Within-subject change in vastus lateralis gene expression across three time points in young healthy men: LS0 (baseline) -> LS10 (10 d unilateral lower-limb suspension, unloading) -> AR21 (21 d resistance-exercise active recovery). The exercise effect is AR21 vs LS10 (21 d of resistance training after unloading); LS10 vs LS0 is the unloading (inactivity) effect; AR21 vs LS0 tests return to baseline.
planned_contrasts: LS10 vs LS0 (S3.3.p1, Fig 4B; paper: 95 of 290 NMJ genes at q<0.05)
AR21 vs LS10 (S3.3.p1, Fig 4C; paper: 114 of 290 NMJ genes at q<0.05) - exercise contrast
AR21 vs LS0 (S3.3.p1, Fig 4D; paper: 24 of 290 NMJ genes at q<0.05)
repeated_measure_unit: participant (paired analysis adjusted for subject ID, S2.7.3.p1)
inclusion: 12 recruited; 1 dropped after baseline, 2 declined the AR21 biopsy (S3.p1) -> GEO has 11 subjects, 31 samples (11 baseline, 11 ULLS, 9 AR)
paper_method: RSEM counts -> edgeR filterByExpr (20,555 genes) -> voom with quantile normalization -> limma eBayes, adjusted for subject ID (paired) (S2.7.3.p1); DEG counts and volcanoes reported only for a pre-selected set of 290 NMJ genes (12 MSigDB v7.4 pathways, Data S1) and 33 ion-channel genes (S2.9.p1)
paper_results: NMJ genes q<0.05: LS10 vs LS0 95, AR21 vs LS10 114, AR21 vs LS0 24; leading-edge: COLQ down at LS10 / up at AR21; CHRNA1, CHRND up at LS10 / down at AR21 (S3.3.p2, Fig 5)
